## Descarga

| Archivo | Para quién |
|---------|------------|
| [MODULORIPS_vVERSION_Windows_completo.zip](https://github.com/jcmencop2021/validarips/releases/download/vVERSION/MODULORIPS_vVERSION_Windows_completo.zip) | Recomendado: exe + código + instrucciones |
| [ModuloRIPS948.exe](https://github.com/jcmencop2021/validarips/releases/download/vVERSION/ModuloRIPS948.exe) | Solo Windows, sin Python |
| [MODULO_RIPS_948_vVERSION.zip](https://github.com/jcmencop2021/validarips/releases/download/vVERSION/MODULO_RIPS_948_vVERSION.zip) | Actualizar solo carpeta Python |

**Release:** https://github.com/jcmencop2021/validarips/releases/tag/vVERSION

### Windows (exe)
1. Descargue el **completo** o solo **ModuloRIPS948.exe**.
2. Extraiga si es ZIP; doble clic en `ModuloRIPS948.exe`.
3. En la app, cartel naranja: **VERSION VERSION** o superior.

### Windows (Python)
1. Extraiga `MODULO_RIPS_948_vVERSION.zip` en su carpeta de trabajo.
2. `python -m pip install -r requirements.txt`
3. `python scripts\init_template.py` y luego `python app.py`.

Novedad vVERSION: <resumen corto>.

Instrucciones amplias: `COMO_DESCARGAR.txt` en la raíz del repo.
